$description: Tacit Design tokens, the one source (kit v0, 2026-10-24). Three tiers as Material 3 has them: reference (the wallpaper's palette from matugen, and the five APCA ink levels the shell solves on it), roles (what apps ask for), and part values. Names are roles; values are private and may change between releases. tools/generate.py writes the token block of the shell's Tacit.qml, generated/tokens.css and generated/tables.md from this file.

palette.$description: matugen's scheme for the wallpaper (~/.local/state/quickshell/user/generated/colors.json), Appearance.m3colors in the shell

ink.$description: APCA Lc each ink reaches on surface_container_low, solved along the palette's hue (Appearance.inkFor)

inkMain.$description: names, titles, the line in focus

inkMeta.$description: a name beside a name, ordinals, rail counts. Lc 75 on the ground under the pointer on a selected row (currentHoverGround), about 80 on the plain ground

hairline.$description: the one line under a header, rail to page

accent.$description: the current place, the primary action's ring, what is playing, a selection ring, the caret; never text

inkOnAccent.$description: text on an accent fill. Was onAccent, which QML takes for a signal handler (on + capital): its binding never ran and the text was black

risk.$description: a destructive action, always last, always with the warning symbol. Solved along the palette's error colour to Lc 75 on the ground, as the text inks are (it was the palette's error itself: Lc 71)

ground.$description: the ground slabs and panels stand on (the shell's)

raised.$description: a slab raised from the shell's ground; not inside app windows

windowGround.$description: an app window's ground, drawn at windowSeeThrough. The apps that parse the terminal's ground (sequences.txt OSC 11) never match it (it is written with an alpha, ']11;[100]#...') and fall back to this; foot's own ground is one step from it

container.$description: a field in use (the search field open); drawn at windowSeeThrough; never a group inside content. Not the docked panel: a solid layer over the see-through page read as a flat grey patch (2026-10-25); the panel is the page lifted by wash.action

quiet.$description: context lines: lyrics still to come, an unplayed waveform

past.$description: lyrics already sung, the empty track of a line

overlay.$description: a menu over content: solid (text under it must not show through), the window's ground a fifth of the way to the accent's container, as Praxis's menus have it

currentHoverGround.$description: the ground under the pointer on a selected row: wash.currentHover of the main ink over the ground. The meta ink is solved on it

overlayLit.$description: a menu line under the cursor or the pointer: wash.current of the main ink over the overlay. The overlay inks are solved on it

overlayMeta.$description: meta text on the overlay (a menu's headings and details): Lc 75 on overlayLit, so on every line

overlayRisk.$description: the risk ink on the overlay (a menu's risk line): Lc 75 on overlayLit

paper.$description: a document's page (white paper, as it prints): the main ink, so it carries the wallpaper's hue

paperInk.$description: a document's own text on the page

paperInkSec.$description: quieter document text on the page: bylines, captions, table heads. Solved to Lc 78 on the paper, above the small-text floor of 75

paperRule.$description: rules and table lines on the page

paperMark.$description: the app's own marks on the page (caret, link, comment underline): the accent, moved until Lc 75 on the paper

paperWash.$description: a highlight on the page (selection, a comment's text, what an action changed): the accent at 20 % over the paper

wash.$description: inkMain over the ground at these amounts

action.$description: the rail's one action (Shuffle all); a field in a panel; the docked panel itself, over the see-through page

hoverSmall.$description: hover on a small round target (an icon button): 5 % does not show on 36 px

currentHover.$description: the pointer on a selected row: a step over the selection

size.$description: type sizes in px; hierarchy by size and weight

alarm.$description: big lines (lyrics), a stage subject at half width

section.$description: an album on an artist page, the line under a stage subject

body.$description: section headings, rich row titles, the one sentence of an empty or failed page

row.$description: row names and facts, actions, rail labels

fileText.$description: file text in Tacit Mono (Mono reads small at 13)

font.$description: the cuts of Tacit Sans and the code face; Display only for one-line titles

weight.$description: weights on Tacit Sans's wght axis; the shell's text is 450, so is the kit's

menuRow.$description: a line in a menu (Praxis's menus)

list.$description: the most a list of names with one number may take

scrollBar.$description: the scroll bar's thickness (the shell's StyledScrollBar)

art.$description: small art up to 32 px, key caps

row.$description: rows, washes, art up to 72 px

rowSlab.$deprecated: no users; rows are 8. Goes after one release.

slab.$description: Slab, fields, large art, a ring around a picture

motion.$description: named schemes (approved 2026-10-24, version B): large things land and stop, the keyboard is never behind, bounce only on small direct feedback; Kit.reducedMotion makes every one 0 ms and stops the stretch

arriveSmall.$description: a field growing, rows moving to new places

fade.$description: content fading in after its surface starts moving

fadeFast.$description: content changing with the selection, rows leaving a filter

spring.$description: small direct feedback only: a switch knob, a pressed button returning

notice.$description: how long a notice stays; it waits while the pointer is on it or focus is in it, then stays this long again

barStays.$description: how long the scroll bar stays after the view stops, before it fades

confirmWait.$description: how long a button that asks "Are you sure" in place keeps the question before the words go back (unlike other motion, reduced motion does not shorten it)

press.$description: a Slab, the transport ring or a slider's knob pressed and returning (ease-out cubic)

tone.$description: a fill or a knob changing colour (a Slab's hover fill, a Switch)

reveal.$description: a slider's knob appearing and going

follow.$description: content following its panel: the wait before it fades in, and the time it fades out

sweep.$description: one pass of the stretch that runs along a line while the end is not known (the header's reading line, an endless Progress); the only endless motion

focusRing.$description: the keyboard focus ring's width, in the accent; 2 px outside the item; shown from the first key, hidden at the next pointer click
